title: MG-EDA: Maturity-Gated Skew-Normal Estimation of Distribution Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2611.26938v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gaussian estimation of distribution algorithms shrink their variance on slopes and stall far from the optimum. This paper equips the corrections that act along the direction of movement -- a mean shift, an elongation of the covariance along the path and a skewness -- with the rule they lack: a calibrated gate, driven by a maturity statistic of the population, decides whether, how strongly and for how long each correction acts, and when the gate is closed the algorithm is exactly the estimation of multivariate normal algorithm (EMNA). The statistic is a cumulative path of whitened mean shifts with an inverse-Wishart correction, whose expectation is one under a null model without systematic movement and whose quantiles give thresholds with known false-alarm rate. translated_title: MG-EDA：成熟度门控的偏态正态分布估计算法
translated_abstract: 高斯分布估计算法在适应度地形斜坡上会收缩其方差，并在远离最优点处停滞不前。本文为沿运动方向起作用的三项修正——均值偏移、沿路径方向的协方差拉伸以及偏度——配备了它们所缺失的规则：一个由种群成熟度统计量驱动的校准门控，决定每项修正是否起作用、作用强度多大以及持续多长时间；当门控关闭时，该算法恰好退化为多元正态分布估计算法（EMNA）。该统计量是白化均值偏移的累积路径并带有逆Wishart修正，在无系统运动的零模型下其期望为1，其分位数给出具有已知误报率的阈值。它将三项修正作为同一个矩阵采样方程中的三个秩一项进行门控，其中偏度由保持估计均值的偏态正态采样器承载。
tldr: 该论文提出MG-EDA算法，通过种群成熟度统计量驱动的校准门控来调控均值偏移、协方差拉伸和偏度三项修正，解决了高斯分布估计算法在斜坡上因方差收缩而停滞的问题，且门控关闭时算法精确退化为标准EMNA。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MG-EDA, which gates mean-shift, covariance elongation, and skewness corrections with a calibrated population maturity statistic to resolve the variance-shrinkage stalling of Gaussian EDAs, reverting exactly to EMNA when the gate closes.
